change.description: Edged US states that OMA01-1 and OMA01-2 completed structural topping out on September 11; this is not commissioning or operating capacity.

impact.consequence: Structural completion reduces one early construction dependency; 200MW remains capacity to be delivered upon completion, not live supply.

sources.finding: The release says OMA01-1 and OMA01-2 completed structural framework/topping out, and the campus will deliver up to 200MW upon completion.

change.description: Aligned announced September 10 groundbreaking for its three-facility Project Phoenix campus; the release does not claim commissioning.

impact.affected: Western Pennsylvania data-center development and dedicated-power planning
impact.consequence: A 2GW campus entering construction is a material pipeline addition; delivery and power outcomes remain prospective.

sources.finding: Aligned announced a three-facility 2GW campus groundbreaking and described future onsite power and cooling.

change.description: Weld County approved USR26-0019 for Global AI (Colorado), LLC; it is a specific land-use approval, not blanket authorization.

impact.affected: Data-center siting and permitting in Weld County, Colorado
impact.consequence: The first county data-center USR clears the specific land-use step; building, utility, environmental and future-expansion approvals remain required.

sources.finding: The Board approved USR26-0019 5-0 and the page explicitly preserves other permits and future-phase review.

change.description: ERCOT began issuing verification RFIs, adding the document-and-attestation step to existing Batch Zero coverage.

impact.affected: Texas large-load, including data-center, interconnection pipeline
impact.consequence: Complete responses are due within 10 business days, with a requestable extension up to five business days; incomplete or late responses are excluded from Batch Zero. No project list or MW total is disclosed.

sources.finding: ERCOT began Batch Zero verification RFIs and permits a request for up to five additional business days; noncompliance excludes the load from the process.
